Feature: Added 'My Mods' feature that lets users save ingredient preferences and apply them to any order with a single tap.
Source: QSR Magazine; NRN; Taco Bell newsroom
Notes: Over 50% of TB orders include a customization; directly reduces ordering friction for repeat customizers.

Feature: Added 'My Menu' section that saves favorite orders and surfaces personalized recommendations.
Source: QSR Magazine; NRN; Taco Bell newsroom
Notes: Pairs with My Mods as a unified personalization layer. Recommendations are algorithmic based on past orders.

Feature: Redesigned loyalty hub with a dedicated 'Tuesday Drops' section for easy one-tap access to weekly exclusive deals.
Source: QSR Magazine; NRN; Taco Bell newsroom
Notes: Makes weekly cadence a design element, not just a promo mechanic. Creates habitual re-engagement hook.

Feature: Redesigned loyalty hub consolidates points balance and full order history into a single screen.
Source: QSR Magazine; NRN; Taco Bell newsroom
Notes: Positions loyalty as a tracking tool not just a discount mechanism.

Feature: Announced upcoming lock screen order tracking widget for iOS/Android (not yet live in app).
Notes: Announced alongside August redesign but listed as 'upcoming.' Also announced: group ordering and updated search/discovery.

Feature: Launched three-tier loyalty structure (Green / Gold / Reserve) with differentiated star-earning rates (1.0 / 1.2 / 1.7 stars per $1).
Source: Official Starbucks newsroom; Fast Company; Newsweek
Notes: Top 5% auto-assigned to Reserve, next 20% to Gold. Green stars expire in 6 months; Gold/Reserve never expire.

Feature: Added a new 60-star redemption tier that gives members $2 off any item.
Notes: New lower-cost redemption option. Lowers the barrier to first redemption.

Feature: Launched 'Free Mod Mondays' — all members get one free drink modification on the first Monday of each month.
Source: Official Starbucks newsroom; Loyalty & Reward Co
Notes: Available to all tiers including Green. Creates a predictable content/promotion cadence visible in the app.

Feature: Expanding 'Ready on Arrival' geofencing that detects when a mobile-order customer is within ~3 minutes and starts preparing their order automatically.
Source: Restaurant Dive; Customer Experience Dive; Grocery Gazette
Notes: Aims to cut wait times by half. The app becomes a kitchen trigger, not just an order tool.

Feature: Updated MyMcDonald's Rewards point redemption thresholds effective March 17 — new rewards catalog with revised point costs.
Notes: Framed as 'fresh new rewards.' Part of push to reach 250M 90-day active loyalty users and $45B in systemwide loyalty sales by 2027.

Feature: Integrated Paze as a checkout payment option with a '$10 back on $10+ spend' incentive running June 15 – September 10 2026.
Notes: Paze is a bank-consortium digital wallet. Adding alongside Google Pay / Apple Pay / cards. Integration is permanent.

Feature: Rebuilt the app from the ground up with faster menu browsing and checkout; moved 'Favorites' and 'Past Orders' to a persistent bottom menu bar.
Notes: Coincided with loyalty relaunch. Persistent shortcuts reduce navigation depth to reorder.

Feature: Replaced 'Sub Club' loyalty with a new program removing the buy-3-get-1-free benefit and introducing member-only pricing with rotating exclusive offers.
Source: Doctor of Credit; Loyalty & Reward Co; Subway.com
Notes: High-value buy-3-get-1 perk is gone. Positioned as a move toward personalized offers.

Feature: Increased point values for some rewards starting April 4 and expanded menu item options available at each loyalty tier.
Notes: Direction is member-favorable (more value per point, more choice). Four-tier system unchanged.

Feature: Relaunched 'Rewards on Repeat' loyalty program with monthly free food drops and a fully redesigned in-app experience.
Source: MediaPost; Chain Store Age; Restaurant Dive — April 14 2026
Notes: Freepotle returns. Lower point thresholds, selectable birthday reward, 30-day redemption window. App centralizes all rewards content in a single hub.

Feature: Launched 'Summer of Extras' streak-based rewards with restaurant-level leaderboards — members can climb local rankings and compete with friends.
Notes: Gamification layer on top of Rewards on Repeat. Drives frequency through competitive social mechanics.

Feature: My Menu / My Mods personalization layer
Notes: Users report app performance degraded significantly in recent months — loading wheel between menu items and order status notifications not reflecting actual prep state. Feature direction praised but execution criticized.

Feature: Three-tier loyalty structure (Green / Gold / Reserve)
Notes: Backlash was swift and large — TikTok video drew 500K+ views and 3400 replies in one day. Core complaint: longtime members auto-placed in Green tier felt demoted. Green members now earn 25% fewer stars per dollar than under old program.

Feature: Ready on Arrival geofencing
Source: App Store; PYMNTS; Chain Store Age
Notes: Customer satisfaction scores improved, drive-thru wait times reduced by 60 seconds for curbside and front counter users. Positive signal: feature is frictionless once location permission is granted.

Feature: Rewards on Repeat — reward redemption bug
Notes: App v11.18.1 triggered sharp rating drop from 2.89 to 2.03 stars. Core bug: rewards cannot be redeemed even when purchase minimum is met. Issue existed before update; the update amplified it. Nearly 460K monthly iOS downloads despite backlash.

Feature: App redesign — speed and reorder
Notes: Overall rating 4.8 iOS / 4.1 Android. Positive: easier navigation, faster checkout. Negative: some users report lag and payment failures after recent updates. Reward coupon 2-day expiry window flagged as too short.
